URGENT PRODUCT RECALL

FEBRUARY 2016 (REVISED AUGUST 2016)

**Product Name Cat. Unit UDI Lot Number Exp. Date Number BD SurePath TM Preservative** 490527 500 ea. Refer to attached list
**Collection Vial** 490505 100 ea.

Dear Valued Customer,

BD initially conducted a field action and communicated to you in February 2016 the potential for leaking caps. BD has
determined that the initial scope of the recall shall be extended to include additional lots of product. Please see the attached
list of product impacted referencing the additional material highlighted in yellow. The same precautions will apply as noted
below from the original communication.

BD has confirmed that a portion of BD SurePath™ collection vials associated with specific production lots may contain caps
that are cracked which can lead to leaking of the preservative fluid. Our records indicate that you may have received vials
from the affected lots specified in the attached table.

BD recommends that you check current unused inventory prior to use, identify affected vials and discard per standard lab
practices. BD will issue replacements for the discarded material. Additionally, please wear suitable protective clothing,
gloves, and eye/face protection and follow appropriate biohazard precautions when handling all samples, as leaking caps
may increase the risk of chemical or biological exposure. Cytological specimens may contain infectious agents.

If leaking is observed after specimen collection, it is important to verify that adequate volume is available before continuing
with the test. Vials from the affected lots should be processed normally if sufficient volume is present as determined through
your routine laboratory procedures.

Please complete the attached form **whether or not you have any inventory remaining** so that BD may acknowledge your
receipt of this notification. It is not necessary to contact BD by telephone to receive replacements. The completed form
should be returned to: BDDS Regulatory Compliance, Fax: 410-316-4258 or Email: BDRC2@bd.com.

Any adverse health consequences experienced with the use of this product should be reported to BD and may be reported to
the FDA's MedWatch Adverse Event Reporting program at www.fda.gov/medwatch/report.htm.

For any product inquiries, please contact BD Technical Services Department at 1-800-638-8663 ext. 2.

Please accept our apology for any inconvenience this may cause. BD is committed to providing you with the highest quality
products. Thank you for your continued support.

Gail Griffiths
Sr Director, Regulatory Compliance

Fax or Email to: BD Regulatory Compliance
Fax #: 410-316-4258
Email: BDRC2@bd.com
